subtitle: Aggressive, heavily clipped signals that form the backbone of metal, punk, and hard rock. From vintage circuits to modern high-gain monsters.

introduction.title: What is Distortion?
introduction.text: Distortion is a form of audio signal processing that intentionally alters the waveform through aggressive clipping, creating harmonic content and sustained notes. Unlike overdrive, distortion typically produces more consistent gain regardless of input level.

columns.title: Characteristics
columns.text: Heavy signal clipping. Sustained notes and chords. Added harmonic content. Compressed dynamics. Aggressive, powerful sound. Consistent gain response.

columns.title: Musical Applications
columns.text: Heavy metal and hard rock. Punk and alternative rock. Power chords and riffs. Sustained lead guitar. Industrial and grunge. Modern rock production.

cards.title: Overdrive
items: Best with clean or edge-of-breakup amps

cards.title: Classic Rock Distortion
cards.description: Moderate distortion levels perfect for classic rock, blues rock, and vintage tones. Maintains note clarity while adding sustain.

fields.label: Examples
fields.value: Boss DS-1, ProCo RAT 2, MXR Distortion+

cards.title: High-Gain Distortion
cards.description: Extreme distortion levels for metal, hardcore, and modern rock. Often includes multiple gain stages and EQ shaping.

fields.label: Examples
fields.value: Boss MT-2, Electro-Harmonix Metal Muff, TC Electronic Dark Matter

cards.title: Amp-in-a-Box
cards.description: Recreates the preamp distortion of famous amplifiers, allowing you to get iconic amp tones through any clean amp.

fields.label: Examples
fields.value: Tech 21 SansAmp, AMT Electronics, Friedman BE-OD

cards.title: Modern/Digital
cards.description: Uses digital processing or modern analog circuits to create pristine, controllable distortion with advanced features.

fields.label: Examples
fields.value: Boss DS-1X, Line 6 Helix distortions, Source Audio LA Lady

cards.title: Boss DS-1 Distortion
cards.description: The most popular distortion pedal ever made. Simple, reliable, and versatile. The DS-1 has been used on countless recordings across all genres since 1978.

fields.label: Signature Sound
fields.value: Bright, cutting distortion with excellent note definition and moderate gain

cards.title: ProCo RAT 2
cards.description: Aggressive midrange-focused distortion that cuts through any mix. The RAT's unique filter control allows you to shape the high-end response.

fields.label: Signature Sound
fields.value: Aggressive, midrange-heavy distortion with excellent sustain and note clarity

cards.title: Boss MT-2 Metal Zone
cards.description: The quintessential high-gain distortion pedal. Features extensive EQ controls and massive amounts of gain for extreme metal tones.

fields.label: Signature Sound
fields.value: Extremely high gain with scooped mids and extensive tonal shaping capabilities

items: John Frusciante - Red Hot Chili Peppers
Death metal and extreme metal bands

cards.title: MXR Distortion+
cards.description: Simple two-knob distortion with a distinctive sound. Known for its raw, in-your-face character and use in early punk and metal recordings.

fields.label: Signature Sound
fields.value: Raw, uncompressed distortion with a distinctive midrange character

cards.title: Performance Tips
items: Use palm muting for tight rhythm
Use noise gate for clean stops

cards.title: Recording Tips
items: Use less gain than live settings
Use high-pass filter to clean up bass

sections.title: Distortion Settings Guide
sections.warningText: More gain isn't always better. Find the minimum amount of distortion that gives you the sustain and character you need, while maintaining note clarity and definition.
